request: Show the titles of the cards on the board in the theme's accent colour.
pointRequest: Show card titles like this one in the theme's accent colour.

reference.message: Card titles in the accent colour

set./program/columns.lisp/card-title:
(defview card-title "A card's title, which Enter edits in place." []
  `(label#cardTitle :text ~card.title
     :textColor @color.accent
     :anchors {:left 12 :right 12 :top 30}
     :height ~(if (> (count card.title) (/ (- (/ (- window.width 260) 4) 36) 5.8)) 34 17)
     :wrap true
     :align {:horizontal start :vertical start}))
